blurb: Guests can try kart racing with the Try A Kart program, which includes classroom instruction and on-track driving sessions. The club offers membership for various age classes with access to racing events and practice sessions. Kid Kart is a non-competitive introduction for children aged 5-11 with supervised lapping sessions.
extraNote: Arrive 15 minutes prior to event for sign-in · In case of rain, program runs unless torrential rain or thunderstorm; cancellation email sent if cancelled · Refundable volunteer fee required for membership, worked off by volunteering · Damage to karts by recklessness is charged to driver · Strathmore Motorsports Park track entrance on Range Road 250, 1 km south of Trans Canada Highway in Strathmore
